supplements.title: Reducing exposure to non-persistent endocrine-disrupting chemicals and their impact on human health: Evidence from dietary, behavioral, and residential interventions.
supplements.summary: Reducing exposure to hormone-disrupting chemicals through diet, consumer products, and home changes may improve reproductive, metabolic, and thyroid health.

supplements.title: Anticancer effects of bisabolol oxide A-Loaded Micellar/Liposomal nanoparticles on DU-145 cells with deregulation of miR-34a and miR-181a: in silico and in vitro studies.
supplements.summary: Nanoparticles containing bisabolol oxide A kill prostate cancer cells by triggering apoptosis and blocking migration through altered microRNA expression.

supplements.title: MAP30, a type Ⅰ ribosome-inactivating protein, inhibits hepatocellular carcinoma by inducing apoptosis through mitochondria.
supplements.summary: MAP30, a natural protein from bitter melon, kills liver cancer cells by triggering mitochondria-based cell death.

supplements.title: Dietary inflammatory index and quality of life in patients with breast cancer: a cross-sectional study.
supplements.summary: Breast cancer survivors eating more inflammatory foods reported worse quality of life than those eating anti-inflammatory diets.

supplements.title: Tetrandrine-based in situ vaccination via multifunctional Mn²⁺-hyaluronic acid hydrogel loading gelatinase-responsive nanoparticles.
supplements.summary: A gel-based vaccine loaded with tetrandrine nanoparticles effectively treats breast cancer by activating immune cells and remodeling tumors.

supplements.title: Esculeoside A attenuates aortic remodeling and early atherosclerosis-like changes, with protective effects strongly associated with Nrf2 activation in high-cholesterol-fed rats.
supplements.summary: Esculeoside A, a natural compound from tomatoes, protects against atherosclerosis in rats by activating Nrf2 antioxidant pathways.

supplements.title: Changes in gut microbiota composition following water kefir consumption in healthy adults.
supplements.summary: Water kefir consumption shifted healthy adults' gut bacteria toward beneficial types, increasing Bacteroidetes and Actinobacteria while decreasing Firmicutes.

supplements.title: Antibiotics treatment promotes squamocolumnar junction tumor progression via tumor immune evasion in K19-Wnt1/C2mE mice fed high-fat diet and acidic bile salts.
supplements.summary: Antibiotics combined with high-fat diet promote esophageal junction cancer through immune evasion pathways in mice.

supplements.title: Fungal metabolite-based immunotherapy overcomes tumor-associated macrophage immunosuppression.
supplements.summary: A fungal metabolite called IM502 reprograms tumor-supporting immune cells, enhancing cancer-fighting T cells and shrinking tumors across multiple cancer types.

supplements.title: Pomegranate in Cancer Therapy: A Review of Anticancer Potential, Mechanisms and Clinical Challenges in Breast, Colon and Prostate Cancers.
supplements.summary: Pomegranate shows promise against breast, colon, and prostate cancers, but researchers need to identify which compounds drive these anticancer effects.

supplements.title: Naringin and hesperidin protect ovarian granulosa cells from cisplatin-induced mitochondrial dysfunction by enhancing bioenergetics and mitophagy.
supplements.summary: Natural citrus compounds naringin and hesperidin protect ovarian cells from cisplatin chemotherapy damage by preserving mitochondrial health.

supplements.title: Bioactivity assessment and LC-MS/MS-based phenolic characterization of Gypsophila pilosa.
supplements.summary: Gypsophila pilosa extract shows strong antioxidant activity and selectively reduces lung and breast cancer cell viability through phenolic compounds.

supplements.title: Alcimaphenols A and B, oligomeric denudaquinols with antiproliferative and antimigratory activities from the endangered plant Alcimandra cathcartii.
supplements.summary: Compound 2 from an endangered plant inhibits growth and migration of liver, cervical, and colon cancer cells in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: Hepatic SNHG9 links gut microbiota to liver protection in drug-induced liver injury.
supplements.summary: A gut microbiota metabolite activates a liver RNA that protects against acetaminophen-induced liver damage.

supplements.title: Ginsenoside Rg3 potentiates cisplatin antitumor activity while mitigating nephrotoxicity through SIRT1‑mediated suppression of the NLRP3 inflammasome.
supplements.summary: Ginsenoside Rg3 enhances cisplatin's effectiveness against lung cancer while protecting kidneys from drug damage.

off_label.title: GPX8+ cancer-associated fibroblast-derived lactate contributes to lenvatinib resistance by facilitating BRPF1 expression through histone H3 lysine 18 lactylation in hepatocellular carcinoma.
off_label.summary: Certain fibroblasts produce lactate that helps hepatocellular carcinoma resist lenvatinib treatment; blocking lactate transport or a protein called BRPF1 can restore drug sensitivity.

off_label.title: Mitochondria-targeted metformin analogs activate the ER stress-unfolded protein response pathway to drive apoptosis in pancreatic cancer.
off_label.summary: A modified metformin drug targeting pancreatic cancer cell mitochondria triggers cell death by activating stress response pathways.

off_label.title: Repurposing melatonin for its potential roles in gastrointestinal cancers: highlighting the molecular mechanisms.
off_label.summary: Melatonin could boost gastrointestinal cancer treatment effectiveness while reducing chemotherapy toxicity through multiple anti-tumor mechanisms.

off_label.title: Beyond glycemic control: differential effects of empagliflozin and sitagliptin on insulin sensitivity and a shared increase in adropin in type 2 diabetes.
off_label.summary: Both empagliflozin and sitagliptin increase a beneficial protein called adropin in type 2 diabetes patients, though with different metabolic effects.

off_label.title: Repurposing monepantel in oncology: A conceptual mini-review of proposed mechanisms.
off_label.summary: Monepantel, an antiparasitic drug, shows promise against cancer by blocking cell growth pathways and triggering stress responses in tumor cells.

off_label.title: [Establishment of pediatric neuroblastoma cell line and its resistance mechanism to lorlatinib].
off_label.summary: Researchers found that neuroblastoma cells resistant to lorlatinib activate EGFR as an escape mechanism, and combining EGFR and ALK inhibitors effectively overcomes this resistance.

off_label.title: Noncanonical PI(4,5)P2 coordinates lysosome positioning through cholesterol trafficking.
off_label.summary: Blocking PI5P4K enzymes disrupts cholesterol transport in p53-deficient cancers, stopping tumor growth through mTOR pathway inhibition.

off_label.title: NAT10-Mediated ac4C Modification of circANKRD12 Reprograms the Tumor Microenvironment.
off_label.summary: NAT10 modification of circANKRD12 promotes multiple myeloma growth and immune suppression; desloratadine reverses both effects.

off_label.title: Repurposing Syrosingopine for Cancer Therapy: Lactate Trapping and ISR Sensitization as Metabolic Vulnerabilities.
off_label.summary: Syrosingopine, a repurposed blood pressure drug, blocks lactate transporters in cancer cells, forcing toxic lactate buildup and potentially slowing tumor growth.

off_label.title: Ablation of the adhesion G protein-coupled receptor ADGRL1 activates anti-tumor immune response via cDC1-T cell hub formation.
off_label.summary: Removing ADGRL1 protein activates immune cells to fight tumors and works better when combined with immunotherapy.

off_label.title: Synthesis and preliminary enzymatic evaluation of polyol-based 4-phenylbutyrate derivatives.
off_label.summary: Researchers created new drug derivatives combining 4-phenylbutyrate with polyols to potentially treat cancer by targeting cellular stress and energy metabolism.

off_label.title: Phase Ib Study of Imatinib to Increase RUNX1 Activity in Participants With Germline RUNX1 Deficiency
off_label.summary: Researchers test imatinib to boost RUNX1 activity in people with RUNX1 gene mutations who have increased blood cancer risk.

off_label.title: The impact of mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists on fat mass and fat metabolism.
off_label.summary: Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists may reduce fat accumulation and improve fat metabolism, potentially lowering obesity-related cancer risk.

off_label.title: Life-threatening neurotoxicity following off-label ivermectin use in metastatic breast cancer: a case report.
off_label.summary: Off-label ivermectin use for breast cancer caused life-threatening nerve damage in a patient, highlighting risks of online misinformation.

off_label.title: Propranolol in the Treatment of Infantile Hemangiomas: A Single-Center Experience.
off_label.summary: Propranolol is an effective first-line treatment for infantile hemangiomas, offering good safety and efficacy outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Integrated transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses provide mechanistic insights into the pro-proliferative role of DARS in human MPN cell models.
biomarkers.summary: Removing DARS protein stops myeloproliferative neoplasm cancer cells from growing by disrupting key metabolic and signaling pathways.

biomarkers.title: [Research advances in the value of tertiary lymphoid structures for gastrointestinal tumors during the immunotherapy era].
biomarkers.summary: Tertiary lymphoid structures in tumors better predict immunotherapy response in gastrointestinal cancers than current biomarkers.

biomarkers.title: [Construction of a predictive model for the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in locally advanced or metastatic gastric cancer and esophagogastric junction cancer].
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a predictive model using tumor characteristics and biomarkers to identify gastric cancer patients likely to benefit from immunotherapy.

biomarkers.title: [Conversion efficacy and safety analysis of PD-1 inhibitor combined with albumin-bound paclitaxel and SOX chemotherapy regimen in initially unresectable advanced gastric cancer].
biomarkers.summary: Adding albumin-bound paclitaxel to immunotherapy and chemotherapy significantly improves surgical conversion rates in advanced gastric cancer, despite increased side effects.

biomarkers.title: [Efficacy of conversion therapy and prognostic factors in patients with synchronous gastric cancer liver metastasis].
biomarkers.summary: Surgery after chemotherapy significantly improves survival in gastric cancer patients with liver metastasis, with disease classification predicting treatment success.

biomarkers.title: Integrative genomic and metabolomic analyses identify novel associations between mQTLs and common diseases in Han Chinese.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified genetic variants controlling metabolite levels in Han Chinese people, discovering new links to asthma, type 2 diabetes, and inflammatory bowel disease.

biomarkers.title: Oral antibiotics promote triple-negative breast cancer progression by inducing gut microbiota dysbiosis and taurocholic acid accumulation.
biomarkers.summary: Oral antibiotics accelerate triple-negative breast cancer growth by disrupting gut bacteria and increasing a metabolite that suppresses immune response.

biomarkers.title: Non-canonical apoptosis mediates oxaliplatin-induced disruption of spermatogenic cells: implications for male fertility.
biomarkers.summary: Oxaliplatin chemotherapy damages sperm-producing cells through oxidative stress and a non-standard form of cell death, threatening male fertility.

biomarkers.title: Reprogramming the Immune Landscape of Inflammatory Breast Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers are working to reprogram inflammatory breast cancer's immune-suppressive environment to improve immunotherapy effectiveness and patient outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Strengthening the evidence base for precision medicine through the utilization of real-world data and real-world evidence: a narrative review from the U.S. perspective.
biomarkers.summary: Real-world data complements traditional trials by validating personalized cancer treatments across diverse patient populations and identifying rare genetic targets.

biomarkers.title: FARP1 Mediates cMET-Driven Motility in Androgen-Independent Prostate Cancer Cells.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified FARP1 as a key protein enabling prostate cancer cells to spread by activating movement pathways triggered by the cMET receptor.

biomarkers.title: Spatial transcriptomics reveals influence of microenvironment on intrinsic fates in melanoma therapy resistance.
biomarkers.summary: Melanoma's therapy resistance stems from both cancer cell properties and surrounding tumor environment, which together determine which resistant cell fate develops.

biomarkers.title: Efficacy of endocrine therapy alone versus endocrine therapy combined with radiotherapy after breast-conserving surgery in older patients with early-stage estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer: a meta-analysis.
biomarkers.summary: For older women with early-stage ER-positive breast cancer, adding radiation to hormone therapy after surgery may not significantly improve outcomes compared to hormone therapy alone.

biomarkers.title: Comprehensive characterization of MET exon 14 skipping mutations in non-small cell lung cancer.
biomarkers.summary: MET exon 14 skipping mutations drive non-small cell lung cancer and emerge as resistance to common targeted drug treatments.

biomarkers.title: Potentially functional variants of CYP2A6 and ABHD12 in the arachidonic acid metabolism pathway genes predict the survival of HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma patients.
biomarkers.summary: Genetic variants in CYP2A6 and ABHD12 genes predict survival outcomes in hepatitis B-related liver cancer patients.

trials.title: The impact of complementary interventions on pain and disability in patients with chronic non-cancer pain: A network meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Network analysis finds complementary therapies effective for reducing chronic non-cancer pain and disability compared to standard pharmaceutical treatments.

trials.title: [Research advances in the value of tertiary lymphoid structures for gastrointestinal tumors during the immunotherapy era].
trials.summary: Tertiary lymphoid structures in tumors better predict immunotherapy response in gastrointestinal cancers than current biomarkers.

trials.title: [Construction of a predictive model for the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in locally advanced or metastatic gastric cancer and esophagogastric junction cancer].
trials.summary: Researchers developed a predictive model using tumor characteristics and biomarkers to identify gastric cancer patients likely to benefit from immunotherapy.

trials.title: [Conversion efficacy and safety analysis of PD-1 inhibitor combined with albumin-bound paclitaxel and SOX chemotherapy regimen in initially unresectable advanced gastric cancer].
trials.summary: Adding albumin-bound paclitaxel to immunotherapy and chemotherapy significantly improves surgical conversion rates in advanced gastric cancer, despite increased side effects.

trials.title: [Efficacy of conversion therapy and prognostic factors in patients with synchronous gastric cancer liver metastasis].
trials.summary: Surgery after chemotherapy significantly improves survival in gastric cancer patients with liver metastasis, with disease classification predicting treatment success.

trials.title: [Surgical strategies of radical gastrectomy for gastric cancer in the era of immunotherapy].
trials.summary: Immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy improves gastric cancer outcomes and may reduce the need for extensive lymph node removal during surgery.

trials.title: Reprogramming the Immune Landscape of Inflammatory Breast Cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers are working to reprogram inflammatory breast cancer's immune-suppressive environment to improve immunotherapy effectiveness and patient outcomes.

trials.title: Strengthening the evidence base for precision medicine through the utilization of real-world data and real-world evidence: a narrative review from the U.S. perspective.
trials.summary: Real-world data complements traditional trials by validating personalized cancer treatments across diverse patient populations and identifying rare genetic targets.

trials.title: Efficacy of endocrine therapy alone versus endocrine therapy combined with radiotherapy after breast-conserving surgery in older patients with early-stage estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer: a meta-analysis.
trials.summary: For older women with early-stage ER-positive breast cancer, adding radiation to hormone therapy after surgery may not significantly improve outcomes compared to hormone therapy alone.

trials.title: Developing a multi-antigen fusion protein (Tp15-17-47) serological test to improve neurosyphilis diagnosis.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a new blood test using a fusion protein to more accurately diagnose neurosyphilis by detecting specific antibodies.

trials.title: Prognostic model for patients with hepatoid adenocarcinoma of the stomach.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a predictive tool to better forecast survival outcomes for patients with rare stomach cancer hepatoid adenocarcinoma.

trials.title: Global research trends and thematic evolution in robot-assisted radical nephrectomy: a bibliometric and visualisation study.
trials.summary: Robot-assisted kidney cancer surgery research has grown significantly, with recent focus on complex cases and advanced tumor complications.

trials.title: Rethinking Post-Infarction Remodeling: Identification and Validation of Data-Driven Cardiac MRI Phenotypes for Risk Stratification.
trials.summary: Researchers identified new heart damage patterns after heart attacks that better predict patient outcomes than traditional measurement methods.

trials.title: Outcomes of Patients With Hepatocellular Carcinoma Treated With Durvalumab Plus Tremelimumab in Real-World Clinical Practice Who Met or Did Not Meet the Inclusion Criteria for the Phase 3 HIMALAYA Trial.
trials.summary: Durvalumab plus tremelimumab improves hepatocellular carcinoma outcomes in real-world patients, including those ineligible for clinical trials.

trials.title: Association of Absolute Neutrophil Count With Outcomes in Patients With Head and Neck Cancer Receiving Definitive Chemoradiation.
trials.summary: High neutrophil counts predict worse outcomes in head and neck cancer patients receiving chemoradiation therapy.
